# Surfrider Foundation Ocean City Chapter

> > Ocean City chapter of the Surfrider Foundation dedicated to protecting oceans, waves, and beaches through grassroots environmental campaigns and advocacy.

This chapter focuses on coastal protection, plastic pollution reduction, and beach access campaigns. The site documents successful local and state-level environmental victories including plastic bag bans, foam container prohibitions, sea level rise planning, and coastal conservation efforts across multiple states.

## Key Topics

- Surfrider Foundation
- Rise Above Plastics
- Plastic bag bans
- Single-use plastics
- Ocean conservation
- Coastal protection
- Beach access
- Marine debris
- Sea level rise planning
- EPS foam bans
- Environmental advocacy
- Plastic pollution
- Coastal cleanup
- Marine conservation
- Straw-free initiatives

## Plastic Pollution Campaigns

- [Bag Legislation in NJ](https://oceancity.surfrider.org/campaigns/Bag%20Legislation%20in%20NJ): NJ chapters pass statewide plastic bag and foam ban legislation
- [Ban Single-Use Plastic Bags in Oceanside](https://oceancity.surfrider.org/campaigns/Ban%20Single-Use%20Plastic%20Bags%20in%20Oceanside): Victory: Oceanside becomes 151st California city to ban plastic bags
- [Support the Bag Ordinance in Falmouth!](https://oceancity.surfrider.org/campaigns/Support%20the%20Bag%20Ordinance%20in%20Falmouth!): Victory: Maine Chapter supports Falmouth's plastic bag ordinance campaign
- [The Last Straw for Maine](https://oceancity.surfrider.org/campaigns/The%20Last%20Straw%20for%20Maine): Maine LD602 statewide straw-free drinking bill campaign
- [Banned EPS Foam in Virginia](https://oceancity.surfrider.org/campaigns/Banned%20EPS%20Foam%20in%20Virginia): Virginia HB 1902 bans EPS foam food containers statewide
- [Tofino and Ucluelet Take Back the Tap](https://oceancity.surfrider.org/campaigns/Tofino%20and%20Ucluelet%20Take%20Back%20the%20Tap): Pacific Rim Chapter bans single-use water bottles in Tofino-Ucluelet
- [Santa Monica Bag Ban](https://oceancity.surfrider.org/campaigns/Santa%20Monica%20Bag%20Ban): Santa Monica City Council plastic bag ban campaign
- [Melbourne Beach Voluntary Bag Ban](https://oceancity.surfrider.org/campaigns/Melbourne%20Beach%20Voluntary%20Bag%20Ban): Sebastian Inlet Chapter partners on Florida voluntary bag reduction program

## Coastal Protection & Climate

- [Sea Level Rise Planning Now!](https://oceancity.surfrider.org/campaigns/Sea%20Level%20Rise%20Planning%20Now!): Victory: Washington HB 1181 requires municipal sea level rise planning
- [Nueces County Erosion Response Plan](https://oceancity.surfrider.org/campaigns/Nueces%20County%20Erosion%20Response%20Plan): Corpus Christi erosion plan with coastal setback and dune protection
- [Washington Campaign for Ocean Planning Fund](https://oceancity.surfrider.org/campaigns/Washington%20Campaign%20for%20Ocean%20Planning%20Fund): Washington Pacific coast ocean planning and coastal protection fund
- [Protect Sea Grapes at Delray Beach](https://oceancity.surfrider.org/campaigns/Protect%20Sea%20Grapes%20at%20Delray%20Beach): Palm Beach County campaign protects sea grapes at Delray Beach

## Beach Access & Conservation

- [Restored access for Surfers in Miami](https://oceancity.surfrider.org/campaigns/Restored%20access%20for%20Surfers%20in%20Miami): Miami Beach surfer access restoration campaign victory
- [Ban Butts from Our Beaches, Melbourne Beach](https://oceancity.surfrider.org/campaigns/Ban%20Butts%20from%20Our%20Beaches,%20Melbourne%20Beach): Victory: Melbourne Beach bans cigarette smoking on beaches and parks
- [Hawaii Water Conservation Bill](https://oceancity.surfrider.org/campaigns/Hawaii%20Water%20Conservation%20Bill): Hawaii SB 2545 water conservation bill supported by Surfrider committee

## Chapter News & Events

- [International Coastal Cleanup Day: Solo Edition](https://oceancity.surfrider.org/news/international-coastal-cleanup-day-solo-edition): Marina Feeser's guide to solo beach cleanup during cleanup month
- [Meeting & Elections Saturday, March 1st, 11AM, Bull on th Beach](https://oceancity.surfrider.org/news/meeting-elections-saturday-march-1st-11am-bull-on-th-beach): Chapter meeting and leadership elections at Bull on the Beach
